README.md.content:
# Public Catalog Library

A tiny Python library with no frontend or service process.
Search should support prefixes according to openspec/specs/search/spec.md.
A historical manual is referenced at docs/retired-runtime.md but is not available.

tests/test_catalog.py.content:
import unittest
from app.catalog import lookup

class CatalogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_search(self):
        rows = [{"name": "alpha"}, {"name": "alpine"}]
        self.assertEqual(lookup(rows, "al"), [])
        self.assertEqual(lookup(rows, "alpha"), [rows[0]])

openspec/specs/search/spec.md.content:
# Search capability

## Requirement: prefix search
Lookup SHOULD return names starting with the query.
